parsed.rationale: Mild unilateral ear pain <24h in an 8-year-old with no fever, eating normally, and attending school fits guideline-supported watchful waiting: OTC analgesics (acetaminophen/ibuprofen), warm compress. Escalate to physician review if pain persists >48h, fever develops, ear drainage, hearing change, or child becomes ill-appearing; seek urgent care for high fever, severe pain, swelling/redness behind the ear, or stiff neck.
